name: chalkboard_infinities
theme: a chalk mathematics roam — an empty lecture hall down through one chalked spiral to calcite dust, folding into an infinite chalkboard realm that draws its own way back to the hall

registers.name: lecture_hall
registers.palette: warm brass lamplight on green-black slate
registers.scene: a vast old lecture hall seen from the high back row, empty, no one present, tiered wooden benches stepping down to a broad floor, every wall a green-black slate chalkboard dense with white diagrams and equations, small brass lamps set along the aisles, one great chalked spiral marked across the front board
registers.target: a great chalked spiral, wide white arcs wound out from a circled center
registers.loop_target: the vast old lecture hall, seen from the high back row, tiered benches stepping down to a broad floor and green-black chalkboard walls

registers.name: spiral_diagram
registers.palette: cool blue-white chalk on green-black slate
registers.scene: a great chalk spiral fills the slate board, broad white arcs wound out from a circled center, chalked numerals and letters along every arm, faint pale eraser haze over the green-black slate
registers.target: a thick chalk stroke, a broad white line of packed chalk with a crumbled edge

registers.name: chalk_stroke
registers.palette: warm ivory dust on grey-green slate
registers.scene: a single chalk stroke fills the view, a heaped ridge of packed white chalk dust on dark slate, its crest rough and its edges broken into loose grains, shallow scratches in the slate beneath
registers.target: a loose chalk grain, a blocky white crystal with flat angled faces

registers.name: calcite_grains
registers.palette: cold white calcite and pale grey shadow
registers.scene: tumbled white calcite blocks fill the whole view, each a rhombic crystal with stepped cleavage terraces, flat faces meeting at sharp angles, pale grey shadow banked in the steps

registers.name: chalk_realm
registers.palette: glowing ivory chalk on deep green-black
registers.scene: an endless chalk-white realm on deep green-black, a hyperbolic tiling of luminous white lines, concentric rings of tiled cells each ring finer toward a bright rim, a theorem chalked in every cell
registers.target: a bright chalk diagram, circled white nodes joined by straight ruled lines

registers.name: chalk_constellation
registers.palette: cold blue-white chalk on slate black
registers.scene: a chalk constellation diagram fills the dark, circled white nodes joined by straight ruled lines, thin arcs and small chalked numerals between them, deep slate black beyond
registers.target: a chalked plan of a tiered amphitheater, concentric rows of benches drawn in white

registers.name: amphitheater_plan
registers.palette: chalk white and warm brass on green-black
registers.scene: a chalked plan of a great tiered amphitheater fills the view, concentric rows of benches ringing a broad open floor, aisles ruled in white chalk, a lectern and a long board marked at the base, small brass lamp marks along the aisles, empty, no one present

music_theme: a hushed nocturnal lecture hall of chalk and slate — austere and curious, soft piano figures over bowed strings and a slow pulse, one bright bloom of sound landing on the chalk-grain seam
